entities.summary: The Senckenberg Museum for Natural History Görlitz, is a natural history museum in Görlitz, Saxony, Germany, with a focus on zoology, botany and geology. Since 2009, the museum has been part of the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung, headquartered in Frankfurt. The main field of research is soil biology.
